386.title: Safer Garage and better replay suggestions
notes: Garage navigation is safer, and roof accessories now sit on the car. Choose from six accessories in the workshop's bottom tabs.
Local personal-best replays load more reliably, and route suggestions use your saved snapshots.

387.title: More rewarding milestones and event scoring
notes: Achievement rewards, Style Coin milestones, and your shop preview are clearer.
Rolling Hills Event RP rewards both placement and pace, including results from earlier runs.
Track previews, Racer Studio controls, and recent replay loading are improved.

388.title: More reliable update downloads
notes: Improved delivery of the latest game update and snapshot files.

389.title: Personal-best uploads and event results
notes: Fixed personal-best uploads when you set several records on one track in a session.
Fixed reward claims that could get stuck after earning a newer milestone.
Event personal-best times remain visible when you return to Daily, Weekly, or Kodub tracks.

390.title: More car choices and clearer event menus
notes: Car finishes, front emblems, and accessories are available with a clearer Garage workshop.
Eligible cosmetic achievements have claimable bonuses, and shop previews are sharper.
Event RP filters, run details, and the rankings menu are easier to understand.

notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

notes: Event names, cached placements, and Rolling Hills RP run details are clearer.
Achievements, Racer Studio, and Shop shortcuts stay stable while menus load.
Local personal bests can show a podium target without being presented as confirmed medals.

394.title: Maintenance update
notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

395.title: More reliable car previews and saved designs
notes: Car finishes keep both paint colors, and accessories fit the car more closely.
Eligible rewards sync automatically, with checks to limit repeat claims.
Live previews, Undo, and Restore keep your saved work more reliably.

396.title: Maintenance update
notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

397.title: More achievements, shop options, and weekly artwork
notes: Weekly spotlight artwork now fits its card without being cropped.
Achievement goals, cosmetic unlocks, and coin milestones are easier to tell apart.
The Shop adds sorting, and playtime is shown more precisely.

398.title: More ways to customize and save your car
notes: Studio keeps your selected backdrop and car preview, and saved drafts survive delayed controls.
Combine front and rear accessories. Two-color neon and metal finishes are clearer.
Locked workshop choices show their requirements, and the Podium crown requires a confirmed podium.

notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

401.title: Clearer rank history and weekly event cards
notes: Overall RP rank duration is based on consecutive saved observations, so rebuilds do not reset the displayed time.
Rank history is shared between rankings and racer profiles. A local projected rank does not inherit time from an earlier rank.
Kodub weekly artwork fits its card while remaining fully visible.

402.title: Maintenance update
notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

403.title: Weekly artwork fits event cards better
notes: Kodub weekly artwork now fits the card height while keeping its original image uncropped.
The weekly personal-best icon is sized to match its text.

404.title: Clearer rank times and event standings
notes: Rank time is shown in one line, such as 2 days at #8 or Up 3 with the time at that rank.
Event cards show a cached standings preview matched to the event period and personal-best time, rather than reusing a stale rank.
Weekly personal-best time and placement share a row, and event previews do not grant verification or Event RP.

notes: No gameplay changes in this update.

notes: Fixed update packaging so event preview data is delivered in the correct format.
Keeps rank times clear, event standings matched to the event and personal-best time, and weekly personal-best details together.
